subject: Maintenance Request #$request_id Submitted - $issue_type
body:
Dear $student_name,

Thank you for submitting your maintenance request. Your request has been received and logged in our system.

=== REQUEST DETAILS ===
Request ID: $request_id
Issue Type: $issue_type
Priority: $priority
Submitted By: $created_by
Submission Date: $created_date
Location: $location

=== ISSUE DESCRIPTION ===
$description

=== WHAT HAPPENS NEXT ===

1. REVIEW & ASSIGNMENT
   Your request will be reviewed by our maintenance team within:
   - Emergency requests: Within 2 hours
   - High priority: Within 24 hours
   - Medium priority: Within 2-3 business days
   - Low priority: Within 5-7 business days

2. SCHEDULING
   Once assigned, a maintenance technician will contact you to schedule a convenient time for the repair. Please ensure:
   - Someone is available to provide access to the location
   - The area is accessible and cleared
   - Any pets are secured

3. COMPLETION
   You will receive an email notification when:
   - The request is assigned to a technician
   - The work is in progress
   - The request is completed
   - Further investigation is needed

=== ESTIMATED TIMELINE ===
Based on the priority level ($priority), you can expect:
- Initial response: $estimated_response
- Estimated completion: $estimated_completion

=== TRACK YOUR REQUEST ===
You can track the status of your maintenance request through:
- Housing Portal: housing.university.edu
- Request ID: $request_id
- Status updates will be sent to your email

=== NEED URGENT ATTENTION? ===
If this is an emergency situation involving:
- Water leaks or flooding
- Electrical hazards
- Gas leaks
- Security issues
- No heat/AC in extreme weather

Please call our emergency hotline immediately:
📞 Emergency: (555) 911-1234 (24/7)

=== CONTACT INFORMATION ===
Maintenance Office: maintenance@university.edu
Phone: (555) 123-4567
Office Hours: Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM
After Hours Emergency: (555) 911-1234

=== IMPORTANT NOTES ===
- Please keep your request ID for reference
- You will receive updates via email as work progresses
- If you need to update or cancel your request, contact us immediately
- Routine inspections may be scheduled in advance

Thank you for reporting this issue. We appreciate your patience and will work to resolve it as quickly as possible.

Best regards,
University Housing Maintenance Team
Email: maintenance@university.edu
Phone: (555) 123-4567
